you know how coffee is supposed to taste but mostly does not? that's how it tastes. rich, deep coffee notes, almost a smokiness, but not heavy...this is a lively brew. there is a definite that makes you want to gulp the whole cup. but sip it...it's too good to gulp. after that first experiment, i opened 3 more pods and poured the contents into the boodum. not the right grind, so i ended up with tons of grounds in the cup but the flavor? even better. that rich coffee taste with absolutely no bitterness, no sour aftertaste. i had the keurig version black, and tasted the boodum mug first with nothing, then with regular milk, and then poured a cup and added one scant tablespoon of condensed milk. all of them were wonderful. of course i did not sleep for 3 days, but you have to make sacrifices for the sake of science. i wholeheartedly recommend the coffee, but not the carrier. do not order the pods, order the whole bean or ground, loose coffee. this is an excellent brew when it is released from pod prison. it has that beautiful deep, almost turkish coffee flavor going for it. black it revs you up, but with milk, cream or condensed milk, it is pure sipping pleasure. this is sunday morning, sit back, read the newspaper, put your feet up, life is wonderful coffee. no fooling. and just for the record, one of the reviewers who gave this product a single star felt that it was bitter and too strong. i do not know what sort of weak-kneed coffee set that standard, but if you are using the pod, there is no way this could be too strong. the same reviewer also added "flavored coffee creamer" to the cup. that stuff is just awful. the 'flavors' are crude and artificial and probably made from petroleum byproducts, recycled plastic bags and zoo waste. add real cream, no problem. add flavors...real cinnamon, cardamom, a little red pepper even. nutmeg brings out the inner soul of most coffee, it's lovely. if it's a spice and smells like dessert, it will work. you can melt a cube of dark chocolate in the microwave and stir it in. even better, smoosh up a peppermint patty and pour the coffee over that. chocolaty, pepperminty goodness that is like christmas in a cup. flavor your coffee any way you like, but not the fake stuff. but with this coffee, you do not need to monkey around. it's that good. just nix the pod.

boy, did i miss pb until i found this! i first bought this product at the local grocery store and i am ready now to buy a case and have my sister-in-law ship it to me here in okinawa, japan. i love this soybutter! i compared it within a week (because that's what it took me and my son to devour a whole jar) to the im healthy soybutter-no comparison! the texture, sweetness, and taste that i remembered from before i developed this ridiculous nut allergy is what this product delivered. maybe it does not taste exactly like peanut butter but i have missed pb&j for 15 years and actually tried peanuts to see if i was really allergic (only to discover that i am-ouch!). i have been waiting to order a case because the cost is pricey to me..it's just so good. i just wish it was sold in the commissary.

great stuff i am not a coffee snob, but for the price you can not find better coffee anywhere else. after drinking this for over a year i can not even begin to imagine drinking folgers or some other cheap coffee. high grade beans at a low grade price.

note to self: do not eat a pound yourself this bacon is smokey, tender, and very lean. it cooks evenly and goes well with burgers, on blts, or solo. i sat down and consumed almost an entire pound once. it is that good. i paid for it later however as it make me sick. one problem is that after eating this quality bacon, any other bacon will not taste right. but i guess that is the price to pay for flavor.

pop it's a chip! i'ma fairly healthy eater, but i love chips. potato chips, tortilla chips, i like them all. popchips offer a chip like substance,with the promise of low fat. they crunch like chips but do not quite have a chip like texture; it's closer to a rice cake. the seasoning is decent as well. they have a surprising amount of a great sweet potato flavor. the ingredients are okay as far as healthiness. i like that rice flour is the first ingredient rather than potatoes or corn. you still get oil, although less than normal chips. there's more salt and sugar than i would like. in the end i found myself munching through the case of 24 fairly quickly. popchips taste good and are not as bad for you. check them out!

great product, terrible price this stuff is awesome. i use it all the time, in all sorts of con-coctions. is that a word?? anyway, if you like pb but can not handle the 18 grams of fat per serving, then this stuff is for you. the price as of 9/12/2011, on amazon at 8 bucks is riduclous. do not pay any more than 4 bucks from other vendors. enjoy.

good salt! i was at a health and wellness conference-- of all places-- when i was introduced to this salt by the manufacturer at the exhibitor's hall. however, i had to agree with him that salt has taken a bit of a bad rap lately. it is not that salt is bad, it is the tons of salt dumped into most prepared foods that is bad! anyway, i was a bit skeptical at first about a better salt. is not all salt the same? the exhibitor gave me a bag to try when i got home. now it is all we use! maybe i am fooling myself, but this salt just seems to have so much more flavor! and unlike bleached out white rice or white bread or washed out white salt, this naturally pink-colored salt has all the minerals nature originally put into it!
tasty product from a reputable brand but now that i can get the same amount in one bag @ costco for $9, i will pass on these, even s&s.

i like that it's grain-free, but it's awfully expensive i know that grain-based foods are bad for cats. in the wild, they eat meat, not wheat. unfortunately, wellness kitten food is about 1.5 times more expensive than the mainstream, grainy kitten foods, and i just can not afford to use it as my primary food. my cats have not had any trouble so far with the other foods i get, so it's not that i need to buy this one to avoid investing in a carpet steamer. i would prefer to use it more, for their long-term health, but... it's just not viable.

very yummy i was not sure if i would like something flavored with honey because i did not want it to be overpowering, but i thought this was really good. this tasted really fruity, with a hint of honey and tea. if you are looking for a strong tea flavor you might not like this, but if you are looking for more fruity it would be a good choice.

did anyone read about the ingredients? first, i do not taste any significant difference between this and water. second, i am not drinking it for taste - i am drinking it for the health benefits. fulvic acid is a powerful antioxidant.
good flavor although this vanilla powder is not as powerful flavor-wise as i would expected, i can not complain. it's great for those times when extract is not practical.

delicious mixed this blended with almond milk, drop of vanilla and handful of blueberries. delicous. unless your use to drinking greens then this does not taste that great just mixed with water. mixed with water i would go with the dreamsicle or mocha. this one has a higher nutrient profile to those two. but again if you try that little bit at the beginning of my review, i am sure you will not even notice the greens.

all the dogs refused them. we have two dogs and they did not like these treats at all. we tried all the dogs in the neighborhood and out of 14 dogs o.ly two dogs liked the treats. one the other hand, all the dogs loved mellow mutt treats.
can not stop eating them. bought 30 bags and ate most of them myself. can not stop eating them, they are good. more flavor compare to the other kind by nong shim.
very helpful for after meals...digestions this tea is little in the spicy side for my taste and that would be the only reason i gave 4 stars...but it is very helpful aid for after meals.

great for staying alert so like the other reviewer said, the taste is strange. i did not consider them to be chemical tasting, just a very weak mint taste. i bought them on a 4 hour drive so that i would not have to stop and use the restroom like i would if i was drinking a caffeinated (sp?) drink. i have small kids and they usually fall asleep on the drive and if i stop, they wake up. as far as the taste goes, they are better than a cold coffee or lukewarm energy drink, which is what you are going to get on a long drive. i would recommend them.

incredible balsamic! i almost do not want to write this review because i want all of the vinegar to myself! if you get this you will not be sorry. the thickness of the vinegar is not because it's been reduced, but because it has been aged for so long and for so well. the vinegar has a nice sweetness to it which is unbelievable since it contributes to the flavor in an undistracting way. great for topping caprese, prosciutto, serrano ham...the possibilities are endless...

not bad, will compare to korean shin giving 5 stars so more people will read, actually rate it @ 4 stars. from what i can tell, american made ramen is worse in general for unknown reasons, even though i cook with the same pot i would in korea, perhaps it is the stovetop instead of the gas stove i would use in korea, the ramen is harder to cook to the right degree, probably meaning that the noodles were prepared differently in the factories. as for the spiciness factor, anybody who eats regular asian / indian hot foods should be able to taste the flavor behind the spice. in my opinion, everybody here complaining about the whole spice packet being too much must have grown up on hotdogs and hamburgers, or equally not-spicy foods. a tip when cooking the noodles is to cool them in air while the noodles are boiling. repeat until you see noodles become firmer, perhaps about 5 fork/chopstickfulls for the whole bowl (alot of noodles per utensil-full) and you can taste the difference. as always, eggs, garlic, ground red pepper, sri rancha(?) sauce or other condiments are good. in korea the standard for cooked ramen would include 1egg, green onions, sometimes onions, and sometimes small dumplings. red meats are okay to put in, but are less cost-to-taste effective when compared to hams or dumplings.

great chocolate! this is some of the best candy i have ever had. the only reason it gets 4 stars instead of 5 is the packaging/shipping. do not know how they could improve it, but the chocolates were pretty jumbled and lots were stuck together. but do not let that keep you from ordering it! definitely worth the price!

its instant coffee not real coffee so beware its instant coffee not real coffee i was expecting a dark roast sort of brew with a hint of vanilla... my mistake for not reading others reviews. that said it is not bad its is instant though so think those machines at the gas station that you pick your flavor from- that's what it is. i would but again but for different reasons not a morning pick me up. its also loaded with sugar and fat so dieters beware/

good as are all torani products the product is good as are most all of torani flavors. just did not do what i had hoped it would. (a creamer by nestle had been discontinued and i had hoped this would be a good substitute along with real cream. did not work, but the syrup was good.)

fantastic food for good cat health the pet food industry can be one of the most infuriating as you start doing research and discovering what trash manufacturers (and the vets who get paid off by the manufacturers) push onto the unsuspecting public. for reference, do not ask your vet - do some internet research at sites like, for example, [...]. what you will find is that even the supposed "high-end" lines from basically every major supermarket label are horrible for your fuzzy friends. people who trust the marketing or trust their vets overpay and feed their cats foods that are full of carcinogens, cheap ingredients that are inappropriate for a cat's digestive system, and byproducts that provide nothing of value and are basically a way to make cheap profit off of literal garbage. it's a tragedy, as these same cats end up with shorter lifespans, kidney problems, utis, cancer, and a host of other issues, all of which could have been avoided by a high quality food. this is an a-grade food. what you will find here is very high protein content, many meat meals, potatoes, salmon oil, flax seed, and no grains, which is great as a cat is not an omnivore, it's a carnivore, and it simply does not need grains. it has 50 percent protein, which is among the highest you will see in cat food. the first 4 ingredients are all meats. what you will not find here is the kind of junk you will see in things like purina one and science diet - byproducts (aka beaks, feathers, bird feet), brewers rice (aka the waste product from making beer), wheat flour (a leading cause of pet allergies), corn gluten (a cheap waste of space), and things like "liver flavor" (because they do not want to pay for the real thing). i did not just pull those ingredients out of the air - i was reading the ingredients list of purina one. it's pathetic. do not feed your cats trash. pay a little more to feed them good food now, and they will lead longer, healthier, more satisfied lives as a result. it's worth it.

lucky bambo working i purchased a cute little bambo plant, known to bring luck, for my daughter who was having lots of bad luck. well, it took afew weeks after it arrived but her luck did improve. i know that the plant was not the real secret to the change in her luck - but who knows- it was a great gift at a reasonable price!

they leak, but... they leak. regardless of what anyone else tells you, or how they tell you to make them not leak (make sure kap is on snuggly, hold the lever down, make sure the cup is not overfilled), they leak out the top of the cup most of the time. you will have sediment (grounds) in your cup of coffee, and you will be wiping coffee out of the chamber housing. that said, i have been using them for about six months and i continue to use them, because they do give you the opportunity to use your favorite coffee with your favorite coffee maker (the keurig). i have used both, and i prefer the my-kap vs the keurig my k-cup reusable filter because the coffee always seems to be weaker with the keurig reusable filter. it also leaves more sediment than the my-kap. there's my opinion. that and 40 cents will buy you a k-cup.

great taste but a little expensive these crunchy clusters are very healthy, with flax, oats, and other good products, and they taste good too. the price seems a little steep to me, otherwise i would buy them more often. excellent healthy snack product otherwise.

good coffee, but not great coffee i liked this coffee; it really has a good flavor. it's not the best possible coffee flavor, unless maybe you do not like a very intense, strong flavor. it's not as good as, say, gevalia - if you like your coffee very flavorful. the proceeds do go to a good cause, though - helping children gain access to the positive influence of sports. if you happen to be a fan of this particular ethiopian bean and you want to support the cause, then marley coffee is the coffee for you. incidentally, the package design is gorgeous.

a moderately sweet snack as other reviewers have noted, this is a round o's-type cereal. i like the fact that it is not excessively sweet. i avoid most "kid's cereals" these days because of the excessive sweetness, but this cereal is ok from a "grownup taste" point of view (for lack of a better term). the peanut flavor is fairly strong, which is absolutely fine with me. perhaps a little too carbohydrate-laden to be a main breakfast course for me, but it does make a tasty snack.

your dog will go through them fast. i like that i can stuff treats in the center of them, but my dog's an enthusiastic chewer and she's through with this in no time. i order them occasionally for a little variety.

the dog loved it the dog i bought this for is now with a different foster mom, but while she was here liked nothing more then to chew on this. she was a chronic chewer and had a destructive side when she did not have a chewy that she liked. i tried kongs nylabones etc and she wanted nothing to do with them and decided that ripping dog beds and other things would be alot more fun. i am not saying this antler solved the problem but she would chew on for hours and did not destroy anything else if she had this with her to chew on. i am planning on buying another for my new pup as she seems interested in the full antler but you should always start with quarter or sliced first so they understand what to do with it.

beware : cats become addicts to this ... just like the whisker lickins brand , cats seem to have a special preference for these treats ! i have tried different flavors and have not found one yet that they do not like . all 3 cats agree with the review .

these are the big ones! these are the hard to find large fireballs. these are the fireballs i remember from childhood. i recently ordered some others and was disappointed to find small fireballs, not at all what i remembered. after much searching, i ordered the atomic fireball jar and was thrilled to find my old favorite, large fireballs!

good. hotter than i thought it would be. slight canned tomato edge to it i like this sauce. it goes well with shrimp, chicken, green peas, potatoes, cauliflower and probably a lot of other things including chick peas. however, it was spicier than i thought it would be. not a bad thing but, i bought this at a retail location and did not notice the "medium" rating on it so i actually thought it would not have any kick to it at all. i would describe it as medium to medium plus kind of heat. i can feel the burn on my tongue and palate and it actually made my nose run a little bit. also, there seemed to be a slight edge to the taste. i liken it to the taste you find in canned tomatoes. in another review somebody described this sauce as "pure vinegar" and while i certainly do not think it's that bad, my guess is that they are referring to this same overtones. also, you will see other reviewers mention that they would add coconut milk, yogurt and butter to this sauce and i think that any or all of these things would be a good way to take the edge off a little bit. all in all it's pretty okay and i am looking forward to trying some of the other palak sauces. edited to note that i added about a tablespoon of butter to my final serving of this (about 1/4 of the bottle) and it really went a long way to improving the sauce. it took away some of the bite as well as smoothed out the heat. i definitely think that's the way to go and makes this a solid 4-stars. just my opinion of course, ymmv.

maybe not that filling, but healthy - variety pack if your child is picky take note: the apple and pear look the same but the strawberry & banana are in tiny pieces and are red colored. for some reason, my 2 1/2 year old did not eat those. i am not giving up, do not get me wrong, i think he will eventually eat them, but i am just letting everyone know. i think these are a great travel snack especially if you do not want to be cutting fruit. they kind of melt in your mouth which is cool. i would not say these will fill you up, even for a busy boy toddler, so you may want to add a protein or fat with this as a snack. that said, it will curb any minor munchies in a healthy way and on the go.

little too strong for me it's okay, but i would not buy it again. my absolute favorite green tea is made by specialteas.com. it's a decaf apricot green tea. i always end up going back to that after trying other teas. i have even gotten used to drinking it plain without any sweeteners. a cup sounds pretty good right now!

tastes a bit medicinal i agree with pf who gives a higher rating to ghiradelli 86%. if you really like bitter chocolate (and i have a friend who eats unsweetened bakers chocolate) then this may be a great choice for you. for the those of us that like the benefits of dark chocolate without the hard edge, this one may not be the one. this one has a chalky, medicinal taste to it.
not my favorite chai after trying big train, mystic and enchanted chai, i have found that pacific is my least favorite. it has a different flavor in it that i do not care for.

great product! i bought this because my local international market was going out of business. i was not sure how the quality of this was going to be, but the pods were in great shape, no impurities, and aroma was intense. would highly recommend this if you can not find any quality ones nearby.

all the dogs refused them. we have two dogs and they did not like these treats at all. we tried all the dogs in the neighborhood and out of 14 dogs o.ly two dogs liked the treats. one the other hand, all the dogs loved mellow mutt treats.

yum, chips...! not optimistic about the taste of healthy chips i was expecting these to taste roughly like chewing a cardboard box. boy was i surprised and delighted! these chips taste like a cross between a salty frito and sun chips. with no trans fat, no cholesterol, no crazy preservatives to make them look good after months on the shelf. and even though they taste so yummily salty there's only 80 mg of sodium. compare that to your average chip! i would definitly eat these again.

forget the smallest size! i previously bought the medium size of this product. i do not put it in it's bristle boy, my chihuahua loves the rings just a they are. for such a tiny dog, she's a powerful chewer. the picture of the smaller gnawhide rings looked like they were the same diameter just thicker. not--they are teeny-tiny. she will be eating them, but i am pretty disappointed in their size. personally, i would love the medium rings to be thicker so they will last longer than 10 minutes!

packaging was great i know some reviews said that the packaging was not adequate, however i think they have changed the packaging. the tea comes in a sealed foil bag, in a paper bag in the box shown. there was no spillage of the tea. the tea flavor was great in a smoothie that i made. i was very happy with the tea.

i was hoping to love this coffee, but it is very bitter. i have been searching for a smooth, flavorful decaf k cup that i could actually enjoy. i was thrilled to find folgers gourmet lively columbian medium roast decaf k cup to try, but both my husband and i found it to be very bitter.

gluten free cereal this gluten free cereal is pretty good. it has a maple taste, but it's not something i would eat every morning. somehow this cereal did not really taste that good to me, but you might like it, so that's why i gave it four stars.
unbiased review this is by far the greatest milk chocolate candy bar ever created on the face of the earth. i do not even have to try any other candy bars... i just know it to be true!
disappointed with amazon's policy price dropped by $5 in matter of 2 days. item did not even arrive but amazon refused to price match. disappointed with policy but tea itself is good.

a healthier snack we got the sweet potato flavor through the vine program. i was genuinely surprised by how good these were. crunchy but light texture. just the right balance of sweet and salty. portion controlled bags have only a 100 calories and 95 mg of sodium. these are definitely a healthier alternative to potato chips. but do not mistake "healthier" for "healthy." they have almost no nutritional value (1 g protein, 2% iron). so do not let all the buzzwords on the packaging fool you. still, if you are looking for a light snack that will not ruin your diet, this is a good choice. as an fyi, despite what the marketing and package language would lead you to believe, sweet potato is not the main ingredient here. rice flour is the first ingredient, followed by sweet potato flakes, tapioca starch, a blend of various oils, corn flour, seasonings, etc. not a huge deal, but its one of those "truth in advertising" points that annoys me so i mention it.

coconut oil capsules purchased this and flaxseed oil to help punch up my hdl "good" cholesterol levels. not sure how it is working yet but they seem to work fine and i feel better taking them. we also use coconut oil in bulk form for cooking as the fat composition is supposed to be better for you than other vegetable oils. as for capsules, i have read other reviews that say these "taste bad".... but i have never had this problem. because they are capsules i am unsure how anyone could taste them anyway, unless they were punctured or chewed. they are rather large capsules, but they go down fine. i would recommend them.

ignor the name i purchased two cases, because the description and price was right. i am not often motivated by "celebrity" endorsements or branding. but this product really hits the mark!! true bold taste and causes me to always want a second cup.

just finished my first 2 lbs of copper moon sumatra i thought i might be disappointed, but the eight o'clock french roast is quite decent. i am still waiting for my italian roast which seems to have been deleted from my cart. ciao

a nice low acid sugar free it's funny... my first though was immediately "green apple jolly rancher"... which was the conclusion of the most helpful critical review. i do not come with criticism though-- i enjoy it. the flavor is familiar and seems low acid compared to a lot of other packet drink options that are sugar free. there may be a little more color/dye than i prefer, but it dissoved nicely and adds nice variety to the monotony of the flavors available in mix-yourself drinks. i rated it 4 stars instead of 5 because the flavor name is a little misleading-- i was imaginging this to be something that could easily be made into a mixed drink. if you want a green apple jolly rancher, then ok!~ but otherwise, the name might be a little inaccurate in my opinion. refreshing, different, worth it to me for the variety.

gives me energy and tastes ok i add this powder to my other berry flavored nutritional powder smoothie. i do notice a boost in energy but not nervous energy. it does help my concentration at work as well. i bring up work because that is when i take it during my 10 hour swing shift. i am not half as tired by the end of the shift as i used to be. i was expecting it to turn my energy shake bitter but actually i didnt really notice any difference in the taste of my smoothie.

my favorite tea wonderful tea. i think most of the reviewers who hated it already had their own favorite vanilla-nut tea and found this tea different from what they expected? i usually dislike stash teas, but this flavor is just so pleasant and homey. add some sugar and milk and it's a real treat. i agree with the reviewer who found it reminiscent of hot cocoa. it does have a tiny chemical smell, or maybe that's the vanilla. i have a poor sense of smell. it's a very cozy winter tea, but i like it too much to not have it all year 'round.

roland organic buckwheat soba noodles caveat emptor. tasty but not "buckwheat" noodles. although not specified on the detail page above, these soba noodles are a blend of wheat and buckwheat. nor is this indicated on the master case. on the individual packets, however, the ingredients are listed as 70% wheat and 30% buckwheat. i suppose the price should have told me these were a blend. 100% buckwheat noodles are usually twice this price (or more).

exactly what i hoped for this was my first foray into truffles and i must say i am much impressed. i bought this based on the low price and good reviews and i am satisfied. i would recommend to anyone that wants to add a little something extra to otherwise bland foods like potatoes and eggs.

likely product mix i purchased the flavor mix pack a few months back. it was not from this link, but i assume this is the same product. i will agree that it is very frustrating they do not tell you exactly what it is. this is the review i posted - hope it helps. i just wanted to leave a note of what the composition of the mixed flavors pack looked like. i had a hard time finding information on what exactly i would get. i am sure they change could change this from time to time, but this is what i had: "roctane" gu packets (1 each): blueberry pomegranate, vanilla orange, cherry lime, pineapple. these are the high endurance packets. the blueberry pom and vanilla orange are both double caffeine, cherry lime is normal caffeine and the pineapple has no caffeine. regular gu packets had 3 of chocalate outrage and vanilla bean. the rest had two of each flavor: strawberry banana, triberry, expresso love, mandarin orange, jet blackberry, mint chocolate, lemon sublime. the strawberry banana, mint chocolate, and lemon sublime have no caffeine, while jet blackberry and expresso love are double caffeine - everything else is normal caffeine. if you are looking to shake it up or find a favorite flavor, i think this is a good buy. i do not know that gu is the best energy gel out there - i actually think everyone just has to find out what they like in taste and texture and what their stomach can handle. i have had good luck with gu myself and i look forward to trying all the flavors.

my dog loves these... but is this three total or nine total? first, my dog loves these dingo bones. he will not touch any other kind of bone, but these are a special treat. he's very finicky, so i am thrilled to find something he enjoys so much. plus, since these do not have the knots at the end, i am able to give them to him and feel confident that there will not be any gastrointestinal issues later. (my sister had a poor dog that swallowed the knotted end of a bone and had to have a surgery to remove the blockage.) but this particular amazon item... is it for three packages of three bones? one would have to imagine, since it's over $10... but assuming it's so does not make it so. it says it's a three-pack, but there are three bones per package, so it does not necessarily mean there are three packages. one package of three generally goes for $5.99 at petsmart, so i can not imagine amazon selling it for $10.80, but stranger things have happened. anyone have any idea how i could find out for sure before i order?
good food it's nice having a new option that's gluten free! tastes great! ordering in bulk is easy and works out great. was not able to fing this selection anywhere else.

good product, but prefer keurig i used to have a keurig, but the pump went out twice, so i switched to senseo. i prefer the keurig and ended up buying a machine made by cuisineart for keurig cups in hopes that i will not have any pump problems.
on sale usually do not get the breakfast blends but it was on sale and decided at price would try it out. it was not as weak as some breakfast blends tend to be. not bad.

looks fine to me i have not given it to my dog yet (a 6 pound chihuahua)...in a few days maybe...and then i plan to update this review. the bone i received was 3.75 inches long by 1 inch to 1.25 inches wide and deep. just the right size for my doggie. the center is hollow with diameter ranging between 0.5 and 0.75 inches, so i can stuff some peanut butter or other treats inside. the bone thickness ranges from 3/16 to 7/16 inches. here is what's on the wrapper: * all-natural sterilized bone 4" * beef bone * torn pieces may be a chocking hazard * supervision is advised * not for human consumption * reorder # rr22704 * upc 721343227601 * manufactured for tops pet products, beverly, ma 01915 * made in brazil my purpose in buying this item is for my dog to have something to chew on (i.e., something for him to do, and to help keep his teeth clean). i also purchased a kong toy sm 3 in at the same time, so the little guy would have some variety.

distinct odor but i really like it .. this tea has a strong pungent smell that my husband hates (he says stinky socks) but call me weird i really like it. i like parmasean cheese too though and that stinks. anyhow, i find both the aroma very relaxing and find that after a cup i am tired and ready to go to bed. i am not even sure if it is the aroma or the actual tea that is knocking me out but for some reason it is so right for this body.

extreme money saver this was a no brainer for my family and i. we were using upwards of a small bottle a week of this tabasco sauce. at $6 a piece it was adding up fast. this is great to use to refill the smaller bottles. i agree that a pump or some type of pouring system would be handy. once this gallon runs out i will be quick to reorder.

no more struggling, no more fuss never force a pill down your cat's throat again!!! my cats love them. they swallow them in one big gulp. at first it's a bit tricky to use but i got better with practice. some of the pockets are too small so i put those in a baggie and mold them together to make bigger pockets. others i use as is. just make sure the pill is not showing anywhere or the cat will spit it out. my cat did that once; ate the pocket and i found the pill on the floor. my fault. now i make sure the pill is fully covered everywhere and it never happened again. i am so grateful for this product!!! i have to pill my cat twice a day for hyperthyroidism. she hated it! we had to shove it down her throat. i felt just horrible. this is so much better. no more stress for any of us and my cat thinks she gets a treat twice a day now instead of being tortured. she likes the chicken and duck flavors too.

hello. this is very tasty beef jerky, but a little too expensive. if the price was lower i would order this on a regular basis.

sometimes cheap and domestic is better first off, the supplier is excellent, they ship fast and they have many interesting products. persian (let's say) pistachio nuts are suppose to be the best, and being a pistachio fan, i had to see if the claim is true. this is the third time i have tried various types of middle eastern pistachios, and the tadim nuts were fresh and clean. aside from being smaller than the bloach california nuts found in every grocery store by the bin load, they also . . . do not taste nearly as good. check them out for yourself, it's a good thing to try new foods from around the world, but do not expect the hype to come true.

very happy so far we prepared banana, yam, and buternut squash; had no problems steaming foods or blending them; although yam took a bit longer to get softer. i searched different baby food makers and some time ago i stumbled on a site that reviewed different blenders/mixers, most of them were not marketed as baby food makers however review included if the blenders were baby safe. however, there are only few products that combine steamer and blender. i have not tried any other ones, but i am 100% happy with this one.

good cereal it is not my favorite gluten-free cereal. i was kind of expecting a little more flavor because they say on the back of the box that it is "sweetened with just the right amount of pomegranate juice". it was good, just not exactly what i expected. i expected a bolder flavor. but it's a good cereal. i would eat it again.

great stuff i have done the master cleanse several times and the last time i used now's grade b syrup instead of buying it at our local health food store to save money. it tastes great but i have health problems and the last few times i have done the cleanse i have felt really bad and i assume that is why and not because of the quality of the syrup. i only mention it in order to give an honest review...but as i said it tastes great so i assume if it were inferior it would not..
waaaaay good not sure what it is, but this pancake mix is the best. well worth the price. do not believe the bad reviews

tasty and satisfying having just started a new new workout regiment i was glad to try out this new (to me) water through amazon vine. the size is good, though too large for drinking while driving, for instance. just about right for after a strenuous workout. i am not a connoisseur of waters but i did like the taste and did not experience any after-taste.

anyway, our favorite for energy so far is the spot on energy patch. they are really convenient & easy to use. you stick in on & that's it. you can get them on amazon & there are other b patches available that we have not tried yet. the link for spot on is here: they even have it with the subscribe & save to make it cheaper which is very cool.

a culinary passage to india kitchens of india's bav bhaji/mashed vegetables is deliciously spicy and savory,but it should not stand alone. it's best paired with naan (bread) or rice. to add some zip, one can use freshly chopped vegetables. it's good for people aiming at a healthy,plant-based diet. by itself,it's like instant oatmeal,with a baby food consistency. an extra benefit is the hourlong cd of indian classical music by sarod master ustad amjad ali khan. the music is savory... and needs no accompaniment!

call me odd i guess i have been using the kahlua k-cups for a while now and just received my most recent repeat order of them from amazon. i have a keurig brewer at home and in my office so i use it often. i could not quite put my finger on the smell, but when the 1-star reviews mentioned "skunk" i initially thought "bingo!" until others mentioned a caramel and rum scent - it can almost go either way, but to me is a very pleasing smell. call me odd if you want but the aroma is one of the most enticing things about this k-cup - i just love the way it smells! my wife does not drink coffee - at all, she uses our keurig maker for tea - but after i let her smell my cup she mentioned that the aroma of this coffee would be something that might actually get her to start. of all of the flavored k-cups i have to say this is the bst i have tried so far, and as for the smell? no one at work has mentioned anything to me about it other than it smells great. the flavor is not much like actual kahlua in coffee, but i have not tasted any of the flavored cups which taste like real liquor in coffee so i did not expect that anyway.

a little broken up but the taste is great! i really loved snyder's of hanover cheddar cheese pretzel pieces, 10-ounce packages (pack of 12). the taste is fabulous and texture is crunchy. mine arrived a little broken up but that does not change the great taste. just smaller bits to nibble on! wish i could put this order on automatic!

good price for very good popcorn portions we have one of the smaller 4 foot nostalgia popcorn kettle poppers and the kettle does not seem too big and finding popcorn portions for it is not as easy as i had thought. amazon to the rescue! -- i found these smaller portion packets (2.5 oz) and these packets seem to do the trick. the popcorn was very good - just the right amount of salt and butter flavor. no fault of the popcorn itself but rather the popcorn popper, i concluded that 2.5oz of popcorn is not nearly enough popcorn for 2 or 3 people, especially when 6-7 percnt of the kernels never pop (again blaming the machine) and i usually end up having to make two - 2.5 oz servings for 3 people. thats when the novelty of making concession style popcorn can get pricey. with free shipping this is one of the best deals around. i would recommend it to others and suggest that they try one box and determine if the taste is satisfying to their palete, if its not for you, you can always send me the unused packs and switch to microwave popcorn at a fraction of the cost.
not my favorite tasting jimmies pros - good price for its size, fast delivery, con - not the best tasting jimmies, still better than getting the small grocery store size

best dill ever this is a great buy for great quality dill weed. why buy little one ounce jars for an outrageous price. one pound of dill weed, packaged in an air tight bag, fresh and full of aroma and taste. buy a bag and split it up amongst family or friends, or vacuum seal what you are not going to use right away. you will not be disappointed with this product. you may not know what to do with all of it, but you will not be disappointed in the amount, or the quality for the price.
good coffee & convenient i like the senseo decaf coffee. it is not too strong or too weak. it is just hard to find.

good treat, but only safe with ball this is a good product to use in combination with the treat ball. my cocker spaniel uses a medium size. probably would not be good for a large dog, with a stronger jaw. the ball itself is made of a sturdy rubber/plastic that is flexible but enduring. my dog's a chewer, and she has not destroyed it yet. the everlasting treat disks used in combo with the ball seem safe. i would not give the dog the treat on its own, because of the choking hazard. but when in the ball, my dog can only lick and get small bits of treat at a time. it's a good toy and treat to keep a dog occupied. as for the price - i can get a 2 pack of these treats for $7 in a pet store.

yellow labs - the ultimate chewing test loquat and leonard are brother and sister labs. i have been searching for the perfect edible chew toy since they were born (perfect= lasts an hour or so, dogs like the taste, inexpensive). the himalayan chews got 1 out of 3 in my rating system. while the dogs clearly enjoyed their yaky goodness, my more chewy dog ate hers in under 10 minutes. she's a monster, granted. my other dog took his leisurely time licking the treat and lightly chewed it until it, too, was gone in under an hour. to give you a better picture, my dogs are both around sixty pounds and are under a year old. the chew toys that we have found work are hooves (cheap, but super stinky) and braided bullysticks. they last about as long as these crazy himalayan cheese sticks, but they are like a dollar each (look for them online or at costco). final verdict, if i were rich, my dogs would get himalayan dog chews, imported spanish silver dog dishes, italian wool beds and personal massage therapists. but as it stands, i can barely afford ikea for even myself so hooves it is!
tastes like plastic i love the convenience of a bottle but the content tastes like plastic. it might do more harm than good if the bottle has bpa in it.

a little disappointing, but still good i love the bagged bom nutty cranberry maple granola, and was expecting this to be the same flavor in a bar. it was softer and chewier, which is good for a bar, but it lacked the rich maple flavor that made me fall in love with the bagged granola. we did still like it, so i will probably keep them on hand, but they lack the addictive quality i loved in the other (which may not be all bad...).

the advantage of subscription ordering i am not going to talk about the quality of the coffee; after all, that's an entirely subjective opinion that's impossible to form from reading reviews. (for the record, i like senseo coffee, including this medium roast decaf variety.) however, if you decide to buy this, you should definitely consider signing up for the subscription service. here's why: first, the price is discounted 15% from the regular amazon price, and the shipping is free, even if the order does not meet the normal $25 threshold. in my area, i almost never see senseo pods in stores for less than $4.50, even on sale, so the subscription-discounted amazon price represents a significant saving. second, you can adjust (or cancel) your subscription at any time-- even after only one shipment. when you sign up, you will get an e-mail explaining where to look on your account page for the subscription options. so, at an interval of your choosing, a package of coffee pods will arrive, discounted 15% than the normal amazon price in effect at that time and shipped for free. your credit card will not be charged until each shipment date, and you can cancel at any time. life is good.

tastes exactly like regular stash green tea i was worried this was going to taste "less" than green coffee, or have some weird after taste or some other sort of nonsense, much like caffeine free soda or diet soda, etc., would, but this tastes basically like the regular stash green tea, but decaf (we buy it for the pregnant ladies at work) and organic! this is useful information for those who were afraid to jump the gun on decaf green tea - this particular brand is good!

excellent coffee i made a careless mistake when ordering this coffee. i really prefer the whole bean coffee, but ordered the ground version by mistake. the only reason that i did not give this ground coffee 5 stars is because, in my opinion, the whole bean version makes a fresher better-tasting cup. this ground version still makes a very smooth, flavorful cup of coffee. i just think grinding the whole bean is a bit more flavorful.

same old fun dip, but limited selection i was disappointed to find that it was only apple and cherry in the pack, and no grape. but it was a good purchase, but i would not buy unless they had a pack with some grape flavoring in it.

yeah, i can not use these... receiving coffee pods was a first for me. i was not quite sure what to do with these. i do not have a pod coffee machine and so i initially thought that i could use these pods much like you would a tea bag. i steeped it in my boiling water and then smelled the rich aroma and gulped down murky flavored fiery hot water. it was bland and unappealing. i have read that you can empty the contents into a conventional coffee machine and use it that way, but it would take a lot of pods to equal out a pot of coffee, and i do not have a conventional coffee maker so that would not help me much. i actually snatched this up because i thought i could make this like tea, and i would not need a coffee maker. it smells amazing, but like some other reviewers here, the pod process is a bit of a stumbling block. i know that they make coffee makers specifically for these pods, but i can not see myself rushing out to buy one. just be aware before you buy that this may not be what you are bargaining for. i do use these pods though, in my cooking. they serve as a wonderful way to flavor stock and i will simmer them when preparing different meat dishes. coffee is a great flavoring tool, and so i actually like these pods for that. i recently cut one of these pods open and crusted pork with the contents. it was wonderful.

omg! not for children! but, the best sauce out there! i discovered this sauce while passing a small hot sauce booth. there was a commotion as people were shuffling around trying to find something cool to drink for a teenager who took a full-dip on a chip. he was salivating like pavlov's dog and his eyes were streaming tears and his whole head was turning all shades of red and purple while he kept flopping his toungue out of his mouth. not a pretty picture, but, i had to find out what caused him to be in his current state. someone just pointed at a bottle and said, "he ate a little of that!" i picked up the bottle and it was predator great white shark hot sauce. well, i was weened on tamales and hot sauce, so i gave it a try. i took a 'dip' and this guy said, "do not do it! that's exactly what that fellar did!" i did not have the violent reaction the young teen had, but, i will admit, it was hot! but, what i really noticed, was it had a great flavor. most hot sauces based on habaneros have a smokey-flavor and it's usually too smokey. this one is just right and leaves a good after taste. this would probably make a great sauce for cooking with if you want to add some heat, but not the smokiness of habaneros. i would not recommend it as a dipping sauce - unless you really like it hot. caution: if you find the "hot" sauces in supermarkets (or taco bell fire sauce) as hot, those would be a 1 on a scale of 1-10 compared to this sauce (giving this sauce an 8+).

unremarkable first, let me say that i prefer extra-bold k-cup coffees and only occasionally drink a medium blend, and never decaf. i bought three wolfgang puck coffees several months ago: rodeo drive blend; french roast; and sumatra kopi raya. all three are quite drinkable, though they do not measure up to a few of the extra-bold blends from coffee people: kona blend; organic blend; jet fuel; and black tiger. even better than these, though, is my new favorite, green mountain's revv . those who prefer a strong, dark cup of coffee (even at the larger mug setting) should try that brand. previously, i had found the dark-roast green mountain coffees rather boring, but revv lives up to the hype, both in strength and flavor. another great green mountain coffee is their espresso blend (though amazon does not stock it, so the prices tend to be higher here than in brick-and-mortar stores such as bed bath and beyond). finally, a favorite regular over the years has been emeril's big easy bold . it's a very nice coffee, though do not expect the new orleans experience of chicory flavor. bottom line: you will not go wrong with the wolfgang puck coffees, but for my taste they do not stand out among the available bold coffees.

economical beans these beans were very economical and the seller was extremely prompt in getting them to me. they came to me fresh and there were quite a few beans in the package. i feel that this is an excellent product and the seller is superb - would definitely buy again!

sweet but packaging was a real bummer! these jelly beans are my favorite. the problem was that little care was taken in packing. when the package arrived, i was so excited that i opened the package in the parking lot of my office. the inner packaging was broken and i wound up with nearly the full pound on the lot! try superior nut thru amazon instead; they packed them right and it arrived perfect!

really small, dissolve fast. these candies have a great flavor, but they do not last very long. they look like sweettarts, only they are not as well compressed as sweettarts are. if you carry them around in your pocket, you will probably have a lot of powder left in the tin when you eat the last one. i am still looking for a really good sugar-free candy without artificial sweeteners. this one is close, but i think i will keep looking.
no hype involved ! the product is every bit as good as the vendor claims. moreover, the health benefits of coconut (though not widely known) are legion, and easily researched via google.

over all, fairly good i have tried spiced chai tea, but it did not have enough spices. i also tried a mix where you just add water, but they were too sweet. i prefer a stronger spice flavor and i like to be able to control the amount of milk and sugar. so, i usually make my own chai spiced tea from scratch. i get just the right amount of ingredients, but it is a lot of trouble and takes time. then i tried the stash double spiced chai tea. with more spice than most other teas i found the flavor and intensity to be fairly close to my home-made chai. this chai tea is able to maintain the flavor of the black tea with a nice blend of spices that give it a little extra kick with the double-spice. of course, with more spices comes more bitterness. the way to lessen the bitterness is to slightly increase the milk and sugar. a better way to help cut the bitterness is to use honey instead of sugar. i will still make my own home-made version when i have the time to make it. but, i will also use this stash double spice chai tea as an alternative until i find something better.
eh these noodles do not really stay whole. spelt is wonderful but maybe this is not the best for for it. try not to over cook it.

tidy cats breeze system.. i have had this for a few weeks, and i am really happy with it. the hugest advantage to this system is the urine is separated from the 'litter' and odor is greatly reduced. the litter consist of pellets similar in shape/size to the wood-based natural litters, but they are of a hard clay, which does not break down with moisture, and they keep their shape. thus, the urine drains straight down through a grid to the pad (in its own slide-out drawer), and the poo stays on top to be scooped away. the pee will not ferment with the characteristic stench, and you do not have to deal with clumping litter which does not really clump, and is just plain stinky and messy to scoop up. the proprietary 'pee' pads are kind of like a giant maxi pad, and absorb a lot of liquid. also, the bottom side of the pad is plastic, and the pad fits into the tray in a way that the plastic is upturned to keep the tray itself dry. maintenance consists of merely taking the drawer out to the trash, and sliding the pad out, putting in a new one, and sliding the drawer back into the bottom of the box. the litter itself are hard pellets, which hardly get tracked, and it is 100% dustless. a pellet or two stick to paws, but are easily picked up and tossed back into the box. scooping is easy, and if the poo is dry, you can kind of shake it around in the scoop to knock off some of the pellets, then throw it in the trash instead of wasting water with a toilet flush. it takes mere seconds to maintain the box vs. 10 minutes of scooping and scraping soggy clumping litter which does not really clump, but falls apart. when it's time to change the litter (once a month), it just pours into the trash, no scraping the soggy wet concrete of old. some say you get a 'poo' smell, since kitties can not bury it quite like they did with the old type of litter, but i will take that over the overpowering stench of fermented urine any day. and, the smell goes away quite shortly, just like human smell in the bathroom. note that you should just use one bag of the pellets in the box, the litter will not be as deep. i just give the box a quick shake daily to even it back out. cat adaption to the new box: this will not work for everyone, but this is what i did: i set up the new breeze system next to the old box (which was fairly gross, as i let it get bad) to see what would happen. i placed a clump of the old litter into the new box to let him know it was 'his.' my 9 year old fellow was pretty much using the new box right away (probably out of curiousity more than anything). after 3 days or so, i removed the old box and inserted it directly into the garbage, never to be dealt with again. no problems, 100% compliance on max's part. if tidy cats came out with a fully hooded version of the box, it would be great for the folks who have standing pee-ers, but my fellow does not do that, so i am lucky. finally, some say the pellets and pads are expensive, but i estimate the cost as about equal to the old style of box over the long run - and the convenience and ease of maintenance should erase any other doubt. also, this system has the potential of keeping tons of conventional clay litter out of landfills. highly recommended.

the only salt i use--except herbamare and trocomare i have not purchased this from amazon yet as still on what i purchased elsewhere but i noticed many people buying the one pound bag. just to let you know: one kilo equals 2.2 lbs. why would you buy the one pound bag on something that never goes bad when you can get more than double for just a few dollars more. dr. mercola's comments regarding himalaya salt benefits are what started me using this initially a few years ago. many micronutrients, great purity. one person questioned the iodine: no salt naturally contains iodine unless it is iodized or contains some sort of seaweed. you can easily see his comments at mercola.com. himalaya salt has a very 'clean' taste--add at the end of cooking.

better than good these dried cranberries are better than others that i have tried - in fact, they are great tasting and just the right texture - not too dry. after getting a box of the cranberries, i purchased the pack of 6 containers ( 8 0unce ) to give out as gifts. big hit ! i would give this product a 5 star rating !

loose poop i liked that the ingredients list was full of healthy things and had no corn or fillers. my puppy liked the taste. however, i am rating this a 2 because while on wellness, he had the runs. his poop was always super wet and mushy and sometimes it would be all liquid. i have tried the eukanuba natural wild salmon puppy food and he likes that, it's also healthy without corn or fillers, and his poop is firm and normal.

the taste is bad through... i think for this type of product, the taste weights at least 30% of its overall characters. i did not try any "previous formula", but this version does not taste good, it makes me feel a little "dusty". the effect is good and can help me refresh quickly.

my cats love it my two cats are very picky eaters. up until recently, i was feeding them royal canin indoor cat formula. they loved the food, but one of the cats had constant diarrhea and bathroom problems, and the other would occasionally throw up undigested kibble. i began to research the food they were eating and kept finding a bunch of reviews about how the food is garbage for cats and very overpriced for what you get. i tried converting them to different types of wet food, and also a version of a blue buffalo cat food. they would not touch anything else and refused to eat. a couple of days ago i decided to try again, this time with spot's stew for sensitive cats in turkey. from the time i opened the bag to when it was in their bowl, they showed interest in it. i guess the recipe is very attractive to cats. i have slowly begun mixing it in with their old food and hope that they will be fully transitioned within a few weeks. they do not show any aversion to the new food. in fact, i think they are going to the bowl more often. they almost never finished their daily portions (i follow the food portion charts) before, and now they do. i also have not experienced any sensitive stomach problems from either of them during the transition. i have my fingers crossed that this will be the food i was looking for. so far it's a keeper. update a year later: my cats are still very much enjoying this food. the one that was throwing up undigested kibble has not done it since being switched. the other that had constant diarrhea and bathroom problems has also completely changed. they also seem much more energetic and playful than they were with the old food which also means they get into everything but a healthy, happy cat makes me a happy owner. thanks so much halo! i could not recommend this food more.

good taste - have not hit on the benefits yet i have not felt any difference using the essentia water after a workout - honestly the ph does not seem to impact the post-workout thirst, but the benefits from the electrolytes are a nice addition. i am not a big fan of sports drinks so this unflavored option is welcome. if there's anything i can say that i do not like, it would be that the water feels "heavy". i generally drink a generic bottled spring water (the tap water is very hard and tastes off to me) and in comparison the essentia felt almost thick on the tongue. for the green folks, the bottle itself is listed as bpa free (pet 1) but it is not biodegradable (but it will not leech into the soil either - it simply will not breakdown). the purification method the company lists on their website is microfiltration, uv sterilization and reverse osmosis. for those who are not familiar with these processes, safe to say that it really will not matter where the original water source originates from if these processes are used. both microfiltration and reverse osmosis will remove most of the large particles and the uv light will kill off the organisms. using a spring water source would really be irrelevant at this point because you would essentially be stripping everything out of the water, leaving nothing but simple h2o. all-in-all, the essentia did not taste bad, and the flavorless electrolyte source is a great option if you are not a sports drink fan. also, the fact that it did not taste "salty" like the disani-type waters was a big plus for me.

strong & rich flavor if you do not like strong coffee, you probably will not like this. i thought it had a very good, rich flavor. i do not care much for columbian or some dark roasts, but i thought this was good. will buy again.

great taste! i love this coffee! i am not a strong coffee drinker and this coffee is perfect! i have no problems with it working in my cuisinart keurig brewer, i aways get the perfect tasting cup of coffee. i gave it 3 stars because one of the 2 packs contained only 13 k-cups and not the 24 that it was supposed to have. the decaf 24-count (pack of 2) arrived with the correct amount of k-cups and is as yummy as the high test!

they like it my 4.5 yr old female torti eats this happily; then again, she eats just about anything! my 3.5 yr old black & white male also eats it happlily; he will not touch any other canned food i have tried including all other wellness flavors. they both also eat royal canin light dry food. there is no "universal" food that all cats will eat! i just hope my male does not decide "enough", then i start another search!

very enjoyable taste - too bad it has 33g of carbs i really liked the light carbonation and the well balanced cherry flavor. the 8.3 ounce size is easy to stuff into a bag or lunch box. the short ingredient list is a healthy improvement over soda pop. one consideration is that, even though there is no sugar added and no corn syrup added, there is still 33g of sugar in one serving. however, if you want real juice, the carbs will be unavoidable. the only down side is the price.

my favorite cup....priced right at amazon it's a bag of coffee....it's good coffee (i am partial to colombian) and the amazon subscription price is as good as i have been able to find. i do not know why anyone would would drink coffee from the behemoth, keurig, when a senseo makes a a crema-laden, absolutely delicious cup of the same...for less than half the price. i am not a coffee snob...i just enjoy (ok...let's be honest, i need) coffee...(hate starbucks...except for the relatively drinkable breakfast or pikes place blends)...otherwise starbucks is what we used to call "burnt" coffee in my youth (started with 1/2 coffee, 1/2 milk in the 2nd grade...today that would be considered child abuse)....if served a cup of mud like that...we would send it back. please google jackie mason's hilarious starbucks rant!

very smooth i tried the samples and liked several of them. however, i tried caribou when it was on sale elsewhere and decided it was as full bodied as the others but smoother. i then ordered the four pack from amazon.

my favorite kettle chip these are my favorite, but they are not for everybody. in a way, they sort of taste like oriental flavor ramen, but with a kick. for me, how can one go wrong with the combination of jalapeno and ginger? they are a bit rich, so they are not for everydayforamonth snacking. because this is a case purchase, i recommend trying out a single bag before buying an entire case. the 2oz size seems to be no longer available, which is a shame; i can eat the entire 5oz bag.
not bad at all this was a nice drink. it tasted like coconut and guava. it was not overly sweet or have a bad aftertaste.

not what i expected we were having a hard time finding turkey dog treats in our local pet stores so i turned to the web. although these treats were much more expensive than this we usually buy, i bit the turkey and ordered them as they are our little dogs favorite. sad to say, these are really like rawhide, not like jerky. they are much harder to chew and she can not even bite through them. considering the price paid plus shipping, we are not at all satisfied.

dog like halo i saw halo advertised on the ellen show and decided to try it. our maltese really likes it. so far i am mixing it with his old food but eventually will change over. i like the fact that it does not have extra junk in the food.

would have been a 5 if not for the price my grandbaby absolutely loved this food. the package is convenient to open and store. you can take out the amount needed and refrigerate the rest. if it were not for the high price we would use it more often. as it is i try to save it for trips away from home when she is distracted but needs to eat something.

fruitofthecali the package and the fruit looked magnificent. unfortunately, several of the apples were bruised terribly, making the apples inedible. the pears were gorgeous, and when they ripened, they were very sweet. they mandarins were were nice and plump, and delicious when peeled.

flying high! i just recieved my jet fuel this morning and here are my first impressions after just a couple of cups: flavor is smooth, not bitter (maybe just a hint of aftertaste), deep and satisfying. that being said, i will probably go back to my keurig "green mountain" coffee next time anyway. i do like the amazon frustration-free packaging (about 36 cents per cup on the auto re-order program!). i cut the box open like a giant dispenser and put it in the cupboard above the coffee maker. convenience is what it's all about, baby! (i expect at least a $10k reward for the idea, keurig.)

delicious, versatile, and convenient--but too salty i created one of the best tasting salad dressings i ever had with this product. however, i made a focaccia bread with it and it was entirely too salty, as i had to add salt to the dough itself, so it could rise. however, this product is a tasty combination of herbs, all in one convenient package. it can also be used mixed with oil and lemon juice as a baste for grilled meats or even a marinade. you can not go wrong with this product. just hold the salt i would definitely buy it again.

joy tea is better this tea has absolutely no taste. please believe me. tazo's joy tea is delicious and so is chai, refresh, awake, passion(especially), zen and even calm. but this berryblossom nonsense is a complete waste of time.

so so i am a big juan valdez colombian fan. this jamaican stuff does not have the kick that i love from coffee. it's sorta flat. especially for something i spent $75 for two lbs. goin back to colombian (twang twang)
splenda i have not drank or used any other sweetner except splenda in 5 yrs. there is no after taste and it just has an extremely pleasant taste.

okay kona coffee i saw the beans on sale at busch's and grabbed it. it was a little different than what i had expected since i have been having millstone kona blend up to this point. compared to the millstone, the color of this coffee looks darker and it tastes slightly more bitter as well. i did not detect a strong fresh coffee aroma once it's brewed. but it does inherit the characteristic mellow and smooth feeling of kona beans. btw, i brew with a biatelli stovetop espresso maker which makes just about 1 mug of coffee. overall, i think it's an okay coffee, probably not the best, but not the worst either, just feels a little plain in terms of kona beans. the bean itself has an oily shine to it and smells good. i remember the millstone beans had no shine but it was light roasted while this one is medium-dark roast. i think i would go back to millstone or try something else with more kona.

good stuff i had tried their 88% extreme dark chocolate bar and whoa, that was insane. this was a lot more palatable and the mint probably helped a bit. i do not enjoy it as much as their 45% "sea otter" bar, but if you prefer a strong, but not too strong dark chocolate, this would probably be good for you.

stink! although the price is right, they are very stinky! i ordered these because they claimed to be odor free. they are so not. also, i agree with the comment above, some are very skinny and some are nice and plump.

i liked it better than my picky dogs do i believe this to be a perfect dog treat and have great respect for everything that newman's own organics does. unfortunately, my two dogs (male 9 yrs & female 3 yrs) just are not impressed. i think perhaps if the 'cookies' were a little less dry and / or their excellent quality ingredients were just a little more aromatic that they would be more tempting and desired by my spoiled, but well loved dogs. if i break the cookie in half, it seems to release slightly more tasty aroma and i can almost talk the dogs into them.
